_comment: THE IMPLEMENTATION-SOURCE REGISTER. One row per wrapper module, keyed
package/module. It answers the one question the catalogue cannot: which
Python library, or which paper, will implement this module.
THE STATES. Every row is seeded 'planned' with library, paper and dataset
all null. A row becomes 'selected' when it names EXACTLY ONE of the three:
a library, a paper by DOI, or a dataset. The wrapper docstrings read their
'Reference implementation:' line from here, so a row filled in is a
docstring corrected on the next generation.
THE WAVE. 'wave' says WHEN the library a row names enters uv.lock. 'one'
is the seven distributions the engine is built against now -- statsmodels,
pandas, scipy, scikit-learn, arch, linearmodels, pyfixest -- and every one
of them is resolved and hashed in the lockfile today. 'deferred' is a
library that arrives with the wrapper needing it, so naming it is a
decision and not yet a dependency. 'none' is a row built from a paper,
which admits nothing. tests/test_method_sources.py asserts the wave-one
half against uv.lock, and a row added without a wave reads null and turns
that suite red rather than inheriting somebody else's answer.
THE DATASET KIND. A 'dataset' row is an object of exactly four fields --
publisher, locator, retrieved, sha256 -- and it is the one kind whose
source this repository DISTRIBUTES, which is why it answers four questions
a library name and a DOI answer by themselves: who published the table,
where the bytes were obtained, when they were taken, and which bytes they
were. The snapshot lives under src/econflow_engine/data/, inside the
package, because a node that ships its data carries it into the wheel that
ships the node.
THE DIGEST IS THE IDENTITY AND THE LOCATOR IS METADATA BESIDE IT. A
publisher who rewrites a page in place, with no version identifier and no
DOI, leaves a URL recording where somebody looked rather than what they
got. tests/test_method_sources.py recomputes the digest from the committed
bytes on every run rather than reading and believing it, and a node built
on a dataset reports it as the result's 'vintage', so a saved graph carries
the provenance of the answer it holds.
ONE ROW IS PLANNED AND IT IS COUNTED, NOT NAMED.
c00_data_utilities/nber_recession_chronology describes the NBER Business
Cycle Dating Committee's peak/trough chronology: a published table rather
than a method, which no admissible distribution ships and which carries no
DOI. It is the row the dataset kind was defined for, and it stays planned
until the bytes may be redistributed. Measured 2026-08-24: the committee
publishes the table as an Excel file and a PDF from a page whose footer
reads 'All Rights Reserved', and nber.org serves no terms-of-use page, so
admitting the file is a licensing decision of the same class as the NCSA
admission of arch and linearmodels, and belongs to the owner. The count of
planned rows is asserted against engine.unresolved_sources, so a SECOND
unresolved row turns that suite red instead of joining this one in silence.
THE ROW HAS TWO HALVES AND ONLY ONE IS REBUILT. The identity half --
module, category, package, cards, methods, node_fns -- is derived from the
sealed cards on every generation and cannot drift. The source half --
status, library, paper, dataset, wave, audited, refuted -- is AUTHORED
here and carried forward verbatim by sync_method_sources in
scripts/gen_artifacts.py, which is what makes this file the place a source
is chosen. This paragraph used to say the register was rebuilt from the
sealed cards and so could not drift from the catalogue it describes. That
was false of the half that decides anything, and two rows proved it:
c16_limited_dependent/tobit_censored and
c16_limited_dependent/heckman_selection named statsmodels here while cards
525 and 526 recorded, from a sweep of the installed 0.14.6, that it ships
neither estimator. Both were corrected on 2026-08-28 to the paper their
card cites.
OWED: A CHECK OF A SELECTED ROW AGAINST ITS CARDS' SOURCES. Nothing reads
the authored half against the sources a card carries, which is how those
two rows contradicted their cards while every gate stayed green.
gen_wrappers --check compares a docstring against this register, and
tests/test_method_sources.py asks whether a DOI is well formed and whether
a wave matches uv.lock; neither opens a card. It is not written here
because this change corrects two rows, and the check has a question of its
own to settle first: what counts as agreement when a card names a
distribution in prose that the register refutes by measurement -- the
existing card-source rule matches a bare package name and deliberately
lets a bibliography line through. What discharges it is an assertion that
every selected row's named source is reachable from at least one of its
cards' sources, run over all 598 rows, naming each disagreement rather
than counting it.
